decisions.reason: The source changes reward quantities and eligible-mint coverage, not the NFT token serial used as the referral identity or where it is displayed.
The source does not change which metadata fields are visible or their data sources; it only changes commission and ticket allocation counts.
The reward-allocation rule does not change transactional email delivery, provider configuration, or required email contents.
The source does not alter email authentication, dashboard sign-in, or supported-user access.
The landing-page statement that each referral adds an entry remains valid; the source does not necessarily require a change to the supplied landing-page copy or layout.
Changing commission and ticket issuance per mint does not alter how referral identity, badges, book access, or existing prize tickets behave after NFT transfer.
